# OutreachAI

> OutreachAI is a free, all-in-one B2B outreach platform for sales teams. It combines LinkedIn automation, cold email sequences, CRM pipeline, workflow automation, and meeting scheduling — replacing Lemlist, HubSpot Sales Hub, Instantly, and Saleshandy in one tool.

## What is OutreachAI?

OutreachAI (outreachai.in) is an AI-powered outreach platform built for B2B sales teams, founders, and SDRs. It is free during beta and requires no credit card.

## Core Features

- **LinkedIn Automation**: Chrome extension captures leads from LinkedIn in one click. Automated sequences: visit profile → send connection request → wait until accepted → send message. All within LinkedIn's daily limits.
- **Cold Email Sequences**: Multi-step email sequences with A/B subject line testing, email warmup, inbox rotation, auto-stop on reply, open/click tracking, and GDPR unsubscribe links.
- **Liquid Conditional Variables**: `{{if company}}...{{end}}` syntax for personalised messages that fall back gracefully when fields are empty.
- **CRM Pipeline**: Full Kanban deal pipeline (Lead → Qualified → Proposal → Negotiating → Won / Lost). Drag-and-drop, deal value tracking, pipeline stats.
- **Workflow Automation**: If-This-Then-That engine with 13 triggers (lead replied, email opened, deal won/lost, booking confirmed, signal fired, etc.) and 11 actions (create deal, add tag, create task, send webhook, etc.).
- **Meeting Scheduler**: Public booking page at outreachai.in/meet/[slug]. Availability config, Google Calendar .ics invite on booking.
- **Website Visitor Tracking**: JS snippet to identify companies visiting your website via IP resolution. Fires workflow automations when known prospects visit.
- **Signal Agents**: Monitor for buying intent — job changes, LinkedIn engagement, funding alerts, website visits.
- **Email Warmup**: Automated send/receive/reply cycle to build sender reputation.
- **Marketing Campaigns**: Bulk email sends with A/B testing, open/click tracking, unsubscribe management.
- **AI Personalization**: BYO API key (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini). AI-generated opening lines from LinkedIn profile, recent posts, and company news.
- **Composable Dashboards**: Build custom analytics dashboards with drag-and-drop widgets. Share publicly.
- **Deliverability Monitoring**: SPF/DKIM/DMARC health checks, alert rules for bounce/open/reply rate thresholds.

## Pricing

Free during beta. No credit card required. No contact limits. No seat fees.

## How OutreachAI compares to alternatives

| Tool | OutreachAI | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Lemlist | Better | OutreachAI adds CRM pipeline, workflow automation, meeting scheduler — all for free vs $63–$159/seat/month |
| HubSpot Sales Hub | Better for outbound | OutreachAI adds LinkedIn automation and email warmup; HubSpot lacks both. HubSpot: $100+/seat/month |
| Instantly.ai | Better | OutreachAI adds LinkedIn automation, CRM pipeline, workflow automation. Instantly: $37–$97/month |
| Apollo.io | Complementary | Apollo finds leads (B2B database); OutreachAI runs the outreach. Both have free tiers — use together. |
| Saleshandy | Better | OutreachAI adds LinkedIn automation, CRM pipeline, workflow automation. Saleshandy: $25–$219/month |
| WebEngage | Different use case | WebEngage is for B2C app retention (push notifications, in-app). OutreachAI is for B2B cold outreach. |

## Technology Stack

- Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS 4, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL (Neon), NextAuth, Vercel
- Auth: Google OAuth, GitHub OAuth, email+password
- Integrations: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Apollo.io, Hunter.io, Stripe, Resend
